newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong schedules checks on mid-dist desulphurisers.
newsitem.headline: Yukong schedules checks on mid-dist desulphurisers.

text.p: South Korea's Yukong Ltd plans to carry out maintenance on two middle distillate desulphurisers when it shuts two crude distillation units (CDU) for maintenance later this year, a company official said on Friday.
A 50,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) desulphuriser is scheduled to close when Yukong's No 3 170,000-bpd CDU is closed from August 7 to September 7.
A 60,000-bpd desuphuriser unit will be shut when No 5 200,000 bpd CDU is closed bewteen June 2 and July 9, he said.
Yukong has five middle distillate desulphurising units with a total capacity of 177,000 bpd. Yukong has the nation's largest oil refining capacity at 810,000 bpd.
Yukong's three other CDU do not have any maintenance scheduled for 1997.
The company will also carry out maintenance checks on other middle distillate desulpherisers through the year.
